what: The variable-font English section title is split into single characters, and each character’s weight (wght) goes back and forth 400 → 900 (at the 60% point) → 100 over 5 seconds (cubic-bezier(.47,.16,.24,1)). The first character starts .34s late and each following character .24s later, so a weight wave flows along the line.

options.--fx-w0 / --fx-w1 / --fx-w2: Weight at start · 60% · end (via style), default 400 · 900 · 100 — the font needs a wght axis
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Length and curve of a single pass (via style), default 5s · cubic-bezier(.47,.16,.24,1)

note: The original typeface also has a slnt axis, so "slnt" 1 was passed along too, but slant is fixed at 1 so it was dropped. With a font lacking a weight axis nothing changes

from.where: about.html big title We Do · We Are (.id-ab-big) — the original’s .p-about_wedo_ttl_en / .p-about_weare_ttl .u-text-heading span (width-animation 5s cubic-bezier(.47,.16,.24,1) alternate infinite, delay .34s + .24s × n)
